agent.result_text:
When you filter the audit viewer by a name, it now also lists the matching lines from the sheet's descendants. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is all in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/AuditController.java`. The order is:
1. This sheet's own matching lines, newest first.
2. Each descendant's matching lines, newest first within each sheet. The descendants are its children, their children and so on, sorted by sheet id.
3. The lines from the sheet the person came from, as before.

It uses the existing `SheetRepository.descendantsOf`, which doesn't loop forever if sheets end up naming each other as parent. With no name filter, the viewer still shows only this sheet's own lines. The front end and stored data didn't need changing.
